title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting. From the context ("équation des lacets", a σ with a centralizer torus T_σ, the trace and determinant, μ_2), G is SL_2, or SL_2 inside GL_2 = H, over a base scheme S. σ is a section that is regular in Steinberg's sense, i.e. non-scalar at every point. T_σ = Cent_G(σ) is the centralizing torus. σ acts on G by conjugation, so σ(τ) = στσ^{-1}.

What the page serves. On the previous page Grothendieck solves the twisted equation βσ(β)^{-1} = εη, where ε is a section of μ_2 (the centre of SL_2). He uses the ansatz β = uτ, where u is the privileged solution of uσ(u)^{-1} = η. This reduces the problem to finding τ with (17): [τ,σ] = τσ(τ)^{-1} = ε.

What the page does.
(18) Expanding, (17) reads τστ^{-1}σ^{-1} = ε, or equivalently στσ^{-1}τ^{-1} = ε (using ε = ε^{-1}, ε central).
(19) Equivalently Int(τ)(σ) = εσ.
(20)-(21) Since εσ and σ have the same centralizer, τ normalizes T_σ, i.e. τ ∈ Γ(N_σ) with N_σ := Norm_G(T_σ).

Corollary to the lemma of p. 455. The following are equivalent, given σ regular.
(e) For every section ε of μ_2 there is, locally fppf, a section τ of G with [τ,σ] = ε.
(f) If 2 is invertible on S: the same with ε = -1.
Both are equivalent to Tr σ = 0.

Proof sketch.
- Necessity: conjugation preserves trace, so Tr σ = Tr(εσ) = ε Tr σ. Taking ε to be the universal section of μ_2 (over O_S[ε]/(ε^2-1), which is free on 1, ε) forces Tr σ = 0, with no hypothesis on 2. In case (f), ε = -1 gives 2 Tr σ = 0, hence Tr σ = 0 once 2 is invertible.
- Sufficiency: if Tr σ = 0 then Tr(εσ) = 0 = Tr σ and det(εσ) = ε^2 = 1 = det σ. So εσ and σ satisfy the 'numerical conditions' (same characteristic polynomial). The next page adds that εσ is regular because σ is. Steinberg-type conjugacy of regular elements with equal characteristic polynomial then gives τ locally.

Outcome (next page). N'_σ = {τ : [τ,σ] ∈ μ_2} is a subgroup scheme of N_σ. There is an exact sequence 1 → T_σ → N'_σ → μ_2 → 1, a scheme-theoretic 'Weyl-type' extension by μ_2 (rather than Z/2) that makes sense also in characteristic 2.

In the motivating case σ = S = [[0,-1],[1,0]] in SL_2(Z) (trace 0, S^2 = -1), the condition τSτ^{-1} = -S = S^{-1} is the familiar inversion by a Weyl element.
errors: Not really an error: the corollary silently uses det σ = 1 (G = SL_2) and the regularity of σ; both are stated or used on the neighbouring pages.
(18)/(19) give both orders of the commutator, i.e. ε vs ε^{-1}; harmless since ε^2 = 1.
The step 'Tr σ ∈ Γ(E^{μ_2}) = 0' is compressed. Correctly: (ε-1)·Tr σ = 0 for the universal ε forces Tr σ = 0, since 1 and ε form a basis of O_S[ε]/(ε^2-1). The argument is fine.

ideas.what: Reducing a twisted cocycle-type equation βσ(β)^{-1} = εη to solving [τ,σ] = ε with ε central, whose solutions τ lie in the normalizer of the centralizer torus T_σ
ideas.modern_name: twisting by central elements; normalizer of a maximal torus; Weyl group action
ideas.where_published: SGA3 treats normalizers of tori and centralizers of regular elements in general

ideas.what: Criterion: σ regular in SL_2 is locally conjugate to εσ for every ε ∈ μ_2 iff Tr σ = 0, proved via universal μ_2-points and Steinberg conjugacy of regular elements
ideas.modern_name: conjugacy of regular elements with the same characteristic polynomial (Steinberg, Kostant), over a base

ideas.what: Group scheme N'_σ with exact sequence 1 → T_σ → N'_σ → μ_2 → 1 (continued on next page), valid also in characteristic 2
ideas.modern_name: extension of μ_2 by the centralizer torus; scheme-theoretic Weyl-type extension

deep.surprise_reason: These are careful but routine SL_2 computations over a general base (trace-zero criterion, normalizer of the centralizer torus, a μ_2-extension). They are auxiliary to the 'loop equation' study and contain no result absent from the literature. The only mild nicety is the characteristic-free μ_2 treatment.
transcription_corrections: Page number at top is '455f' (continuing the 455 series), consistent with 'Corollaire au lemme (p. 455)'.
'Γ(E'^{μ_2}=0)' is likely 'Γ(E^{μ_2}) = 0' or similar: the μ_2-invariants of the twisted line vanish.
Marginal insertion likely reads 'équivalentes' above 'conditions', with '(e) ⟺ Tr σ = 0' / 'σ régulier loc.' as a gloss.
Last lines: 'donc ε satisfait' should read 'donc εσ satisfait aux "conditions numériques" pour être de la forme [τ,σ]σ…' — the subject is εσ, not ε.
